WITH linked AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, 'Missing') AS mix
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
),
grp AS (
  SELECT mix, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM linked
  GROUP BY mix
),
tot AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM grp
),
shares AS (
  SELECT g.mix, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share
  FROM grp g
  CROSS JOIN tot t
),
avgs AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT s.mix, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS above_avg_by
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avgs a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
ORDER BY above_avg_by DESC;
